messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete archive browser focused on 1996–2012-era entertainment, games, movies, and websites.

## Requirements
- Include an archive date selector.
- Include an Adobe Flash-style player for Flash games and movies.
- Include entertainment websites.
- Do not use redirects.
- Build a complete playable experience without clarification.

## Decisions
- Used a locally recreated, legacy-style browser experience rather than real Adobe Flash.
- Added native HTML/CSS/JavaScript games and animated shorts to avoid plugins and external redirects.
- Assumed an archive UI with browse, save, address-bar, and snapshot-navigation interactions.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full responsive archive interface in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Implemented archive cards, date selection, sidebar navigation, collections, address navigation, browser controls, and toast feedback in `app.js`.
- Added playable Star Catcher/Neon Breakout-style game canvas experiences.
- Added locally recreated animated movie playback controls.
- Added modal archive website snapshots and save-to-collection behavior.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check app.js`.
- Started a local server and checked the page title and initial browser load.
- Captured `screenshots/home.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Visual browser verification may be limited because Playwright initially lacked Chromium, but it was subsequently installed successfully.
- The only observed browser console issue was a missing `/favicon.ico`; this is cosmetic.

### Next Move
1. Reopen and visually inspect `http://localhost:3002` after the browser installation.
2. Test game start, movie playback, date changes, address navigation, collections, and mobile layout.
3. Add `favicon.ico` if the 404 should be removed.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main archive browser markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: Responsive interface and player styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/app.js`: Archive navigation, games, movies, and interactions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/home.jpg`: Initial desktop screenshot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: Development server launch script.

## Important Context
- The implementation contains no external archived site redirects.
- Flash compatibility is represented as a safe in-browser recreation; it does not use a real Flash plugin.
- The server was started on port `3002`.
- Playwright Chromium was installed using `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.
- Recent browser load reported only the missing `favicon.ico` resource as a 404.
